    • ensureNextAtLeast

      public static void ensureNextAtLeast(int floor)
      Raises the counter to floor if it currently sits lower — never lowers it. Used to keep newly-built transitions from reusing numbers already on a canvas they're about to join, without disturbing numbers already handed out.

    • createInP

      public void createInP(ArcIn[] arcs) throws ExceptionInvalidTimeDelay
      This method determines the places which is input for the transition.
      The class PetriNet use this method for creating net with given arrays of places, transitions, input arcs and output arcs.
      Parameters:
      arcs - array of input arcs
      Throws:
      ExceptionInvalidTimeDelay - if Petri net has invalid structure

    • createOutP

      public void createOutP(ArcOut[] arcs) throws ExceptionInvalidTimeDelay
      This method determines the places which is output for the transition.
      The class PetriNet use this method for creating net with given arrays of places, transitions, input arcs and output arcs.
      Parameters:
      arcs - array of output arcs
      Throws:
      ExceptionInvalidTimeDelay - if Petri net has invalid structure

    • addExternalOutput

      public void addExternalOutput(PetriP place, int quantity)
      Makes this transition deliver tokens into a place of another Petri-object whenever it fires, in addition to its own output places.
      Parameters:
      place - the place owned by the other Petri-object
      quantity - how many tokens each firing delivers

    • clearExternalArcs

      public void clearExternalArcs()
      Drops every inter-object arc of this transition. Called before a model re-applies its link declarations so that wiring is never duplicated.
